caption: The drawing depicts a metallic watering can, centrally positioned on a plain, beige background. The watering can is conical in shape with a wide base that narrows towards the top opening. It has a high, curved handle on the right side and a long, thin spout extending and curving upwards to the left. The can itself is predominantly black or dark gray, adorned with decorative floral patterns on its central body. These patterns include green and yellow leaves, as well as red and pink circular and oval floral motifs, supplemented by small green circles. A band of yellow-green wavy lines encircles the top edge, while a similar straight line decorates the base. The rendering style is flat but precise, and there are some brownish stains and irregular patches behind the watering can, possibly suggesting wear or background texture.
title: Toleware Teapot
